list: The official 55 PS5 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden), as published on PlayStation Network and mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this guide was written. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written for this entry and names its sources.

trophies.guide: The platinum awards itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task here — the work is the whole list. Build the run around A Long Road, the 100% completion gold, because most other trophies feed progress into it anyway. Expect roughly 200 hours all-in at the launch guides' estimate, in a single playthrough, with no online trophies to worry about.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically: it unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed and needs no preparation — every platinum run starts with it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1, and automatic like all the chapter trophies. One quirk worth knowing: the unlock is reported to land only once you complete the first main mission of Chapter 2, so if it seems late, just keep playing — it is not missable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2 (the asterisks are in the name as PlayStation publishes it). As with the other chapter trophies, the unlock is reported to arrive after the first main mission of the following chapter. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. The unlock is reported to land after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life), which is normal for this set — automatic and unmissable either way.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4, unlocking after that chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Automatic and unmissable; if you are rotating manual saves per chapter, this is a good place to bank one.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: finish the game's final mission. Launch guides place the decisive finale at the end of the Chapter 4 closing sequence (Starting From Zero), and the trophy is automatic when it ends. Free-roam continues after the credits, so nothing about cleanup has to be done before you finish the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Breakfast Run, a main mission in Chapter 2. It pops as the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist, a main mission in Chapter 3. Automatic at the mission's end and unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Child's Play, a main mission in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Headliners, a main mission in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown, a main mission in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable. The airport also matters later for the hidden Catch Me If You Can trophy, so the layout you learn here pays off.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory, a main mission in Chapter 5. Automatic and unmissable — the last of the named-mission story trophies before the finale sequence.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The long pole of the platinum, and the hardest trophy on the list by every launch guide's account. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but everything you did during the story already counts. It is far more lenient than its name: roughly 60% of true completion, with most side quests not required, collectibles only partly required (scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars), and only 70 of the 80 challenges needed, so the worst ones can be skipped. The categories that must be finished in full include robberies, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting decks. Nothing toward it is missable — it all stays open in free-roam.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four families freely: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The under-bridge flights are the quickest to accumulate. Progress is tracked per region under Progress > Activities > Stunts and by name on the map's Exploration filter, and completed stunts stay marked. Keep going past 250 if you are chasing 100% — the checklist asks for 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (or drone race), and performing a stunt. The Progress > Activities menu shows a counter beside each type, and the map's Activities filter marks most of them in blue. A normal playthrough plus the 100% checklist ticks nearly all nine without deliberate effort.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. This silver sits on the critical path: shooting ranges are one of the categories the 100% checklist requires in full, so there is no shortcut around it. Work one range's challenges back-to-back while its layouts are fresh, and note that range play also raises your Focus stat, which helps Gunslinger later.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 individual races exist, but one win per location is what the trophy counts. Drone races must also be completed for the 100% checklist, so clear each location as you unfog its region rather than leaving a mop-up tour for the end.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 unique race locations, so you can leave the hardest half alone. Re-winning a race you already won does not add to the count — the trophy tracker shows how many distinct wins you hold, so spread your attempts across the map.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is introduced by the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; some time afterwards he texts you a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his short questline and win the challenge he sets. Fishing also covers one of Master of None's nine activity types, so do it when the text arrives.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to end. Four exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is found on arcade machines in the world. Completing a game means reaching the end of all its levels once — its internal challenges are not required — and any one game is enough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It marks itself during Chapter 3: Andy calls Lucia, then texts her home address in Belville. The chain runs five quests — the three-part Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy follows the final one. Everything stays available after the story, so there is no clock on it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It starts in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams: Kenton calls, appears as the green KR icon in Key Lento, and sends you to clear 7 shipwrecks, digging treasure off the ocean floor with the metal detector and bringing it back to him (tracked under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees). One warning from the launch guides: Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns during Chapter 2–3 — that is a pause, not a miss. All trophy quest-givers are still around after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, which marks itself after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Five quests make up the chain: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. The trophy unlocks after the last of them, and the whole chain remains available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers — with a catch: many named questlines (Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses and others) do NOT count as 'strangers' for this trophy. The strands confirmed to count at launch are Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt (Skunk Apeology 101 through Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle's farm and chemicals chain, Yago's street-race chain, and Pete the pilot's delivery chain, with more still being discovered. Watch the trophy tracker to confirm a finished strand registered. One launch-week report suggests some chains have story-progress windows; that is unconfirmed, but starting strands when they appear costs nothing. All of them can still be found in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List questline. It opens inside the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you gain the Key Cloner and deliver Randy a Zorrusso; he then wants 16 named sports cars, tracked under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars at fixed spots himself; for the rest, scan high-end cars around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach with the WAiNK app (a popup offers delivery when you enter one he wants) and drive them to his garage in the west of Vice City, marked RK. Undamaged deliveries pay more, but only the delivery matters here.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is Jason-only and marks itself after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs shown by purple markers around Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter quest); after enough labs are shut down, Tyrone hands you his follow-up quest, Spin On This, and finishing it unlocks the trophy. The chain stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double toward the checklist, and Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations tracks them. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the one trophy the launch guides flag: a meditation exists only during Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and accept. That session raises the counter but is not marked like a normal spot, and whether the trophy truly requires it is still unconfirmed — the guide author who earned the trophy had done it, so do it to be safe. The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18, so this risk concerns the trophy alone. The last spot needs both characters travelling together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret Vogel asks for. His questline is Jason-only: after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He lends you the unique Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker), then marks hunting spots with purple icons; bring him the animals he requests, tracked under Map > Activities > Target Deck. Which exact animal triggers this trophy was still being confirmed at launch — but all 15 of Bret's Target Decks are required by the 100% checklist, so working through them covers it either way. Clean one-shot kills keep animals pristine and pay more, though that is not required.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the world, so you need only a sixth of them — choose sets whose cards cluster in regions you have already unfogged, and finish them opportunistically while checklist tasks take you nearby, rather than touring the whole map for one set at a time.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app (hold up on the D-pad, then R1) to scan 100 scannable locations: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and 'No Flusher' tags, among others. More than 100 exist, so no individual scan is mandatory — weave scans into every trip and the total builds itself. The same habit drives Whip It Good's vehicle database, so scan cars as well as places.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges shows a completed tick on each finished one. Leave this trophy late in the run: a large share of challenges complete passively while you work on everything else, and because the 100% checklist requires 70 of 80 anyway, this bronze effectively awards itself on the road to A Long Road. When you do mop up, pick the easiest challenges you have left — you may skip 30 of them entirely.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone completely. It only becomes possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, which unlocks free-roaming as Jason and Lucia together (call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle). The reliable escape: a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot keep sight of you — the trophy pops once you leave the red heat area, not the flashing search circle. It also tends to happen by itself during the big bank-vault robberies, which force 4-star escapes.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while never fully losing your wanted level — keep the red/blue flashing search state alive the whole chain (partner play needs Chapter 2's Coffee Break done first). A proven setup: the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — bring body armour, sticky bombs for the back-room safes and healing items, loot a couple of items plus the safe in each store, and ride straight to the next. The trophy can pop up to half a minute after the third store; if the chain broke (for example you left before police arrived), simply hit a fourth shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold up on the D-pad to bring it up, then R1 to scan) — standing by a busy road and scanning passing traffic is the fastest way, and scanning is enough; you never need to drive them. Progress > Vehicles shows your totals per category. Start in Chapter 1: the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this bronze arrives on its own if the habit sticks. Boats and aircraft count too.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus activation (L3+R3 while aiming: time slows and weak points light up, draining the purple Focus bar). Setup matters because one activation lasts only seconds: raise Focus beforehand with food, drink or a shower, take Adrenaline to stretch the window, wear body armour, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556 against a clustered group at a gang operation. It reportedly does not count on police, soldiers or civilians. Focus levels up as you play (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) up to level 4 — late in the game this gets much easier, and may well happen naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet that is docked at a VCIA terminal bridge and fly it out — jets parked on the open airfield do not count. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: come through the airfield fence, board by the stairs next to the boarding bridge (or walk through the terminal), go up to the cockpit, taxi out and take off. The trophy unlocks, with a slight delay, once you are about 1 km away from the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank and use it. The tanks sit at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, parked in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot up enemies until the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Preparation first: finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, which gives you the Snap Gun (it silently opens alarmed doors and stays in your inventory) and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons. Then enter a store through its back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, and — this is the part people miss — also destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room before you leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. The trophy lands shortly after you exit.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… teaches the loop: tail a security van until a guard carries a briefcase of cash into a bank and the vault opens, then get inside while it is open and empty it — bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold right on the D-pad to hand off a bag). Afterwards, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (his earlier jobs must be done first) and the vans get purple markers. Every vault robbery brings an instant 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle through traffic, then swap vehicles. There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this silver arrives on that path — and at up to $205,000 a vault, it is also the endgame's best income.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. The bank-vault loop from the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… counts automatically — tailing the truck to the bank and emptying the vault is a truck robbery — and all 8 large bank jobs are checklist-required anyway. For an earlier unlock: block a roaming armored truck near a bank, blow its rear doors open with a sticky bomb (available through Yasmani's jobs from Chapter 3), take the cash and break out of the red heat radius, or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida — every area visited or overflown until no black fog remains. The efficient way is from the air: take a plane and sweep the fogged regions in a grid. Combine the sweep with the under-bridge flights for Cunning Stunts and the drone-race locations, so the flying time pays three times over.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations appear as yellow map icons when you pass near them (many are also marked from story progress); 39 exist in total. Progress > Gangs shows, per gang, how many of its operations you have robbed, which makes it easy to spot the gangs you still owe. The 100% checklist ultimately wants all 39 operations, so this trophy unlocks along the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A small ritual, per the launch guides' reports: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole method — cheap and quick, but easy to forget, so grab it whenever the story next puts you on Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car: the blue Banshee in the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, and drive it straight out through the showroom's glass window. You need the Key Cloner, gained in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, to take the car. Only that blue Banshee counts — it is a tribute to the Banshee stunt from GTA III — and the trophy pops a few seconds after you reach the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Strip the Kingpin Bowling alley in Port Gellhorn — one of the Kolt gang operations, flagged by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling — of its 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, which you blow open with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation beforehand. The trophy pops after you escape the police, and the three valuables do not have to be taken in a single visit — the robbery icon respawns — so this one is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have Jason and Lucia at maximum Strength at the same time; check both under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon). Work out together: call your partner along (partner play unlocks at Chapter 2's Coffee Break) and, while the character you control trains, the other completes their training automatically, so progress doubles. Fitness clubs are everywhere under Map > Activities, a gym membership speeds things up, and after the story you can also train at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile; selecting the trophy in the PSN trophy list shows your running count of 500. Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so every qualifying act flashes the demon icon at the screen's edge: clean stealthy robberies and destroyed evidence push Professional, incapacitating without killing pushes Hardened, killing pushes Violent and Psycho. Almost every robbery and firefight in a normal run counts, so this normally completes passively long before the end. One caution from the launch guides: the Irredeemable tier is permanent and makes police quicker to shoot on sight, so there is no need to farm this violently.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED TRIGGER — no verified method exists at launch. The big launch guides list this trophy as currently unknown; the circulating belief is that it involves the Payday Loans store from the prologue and succeeding at something on a second attempt, which the description ('Second time's the charm') hints at. This guide deliberately invents no steps: check the cited guides for updates as the community pins it down, and keep a manual save from the prologue era in case the trigger turns out to be early.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside — the spawn is random, so if it is not there, drive away and return. Follow the path from the car into the woods toward the bright blue light, approach the UFO, and when it drops the woman it abducted, talk to her, offer help and take her back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED TRIGGER — no verified method exists at launch. The description asks you to bowl people over with a melee drive-by, and the launch guides list the exact method as currently unknown; the working belief is that it involves kicking pedestrians while riding a motorcycle. This guide invents no confirmed steps: try the motorcycle-kick theory opportunistically as you travel, and watch the cited guides — they are updating daily as players verify it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your fences — it does not have to arrive in one delivery. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for marked bills; then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence, with Yasmani in Vice City paying the most. Once Chapter 4 opens the bank vaults (up to $205,000 each), the total comes quickly, and the checklist's robbery requirements mean most of it accrues anyway.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops of every kind. The fastest sinks are the expensive ones — weapons at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, tattoos — but ordinary play, outfitting both characters and keeping vehicles repaired usually crosses the line without any deliberate farming. There is no single-shop requirement; every till counts.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties (the 4 garages the story gives you do not count). Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — you buy them right in the app, $160,000 in total. Fund them with the robbery income that opens up in Chapters 3–4, and buy early rather than late: the parking spots these garages add are what On the Spot's vehicle registrations need.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. Registration slots come from your garages, so Little Boxes comes first. Early on Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money per vehicle, so feed it cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
